name: iron-cross-dumbbell
title: Iron Cross: Dumbbell
primer: This is an advanced exercise that works the whole body.
steps: With a dumbbell in each hand, stand in a low squat stance, your feet shoulder width apart and your arms held out in front of you with your palms facing in.
Standing upright, move your arms out and away from your body forming a "T" or "cross".
tips: Do this exercise with light weights until you are comfortable with the movements.
